name: Nami
notes: Surging Tides (P) only grants allied champions bonus movement speed, so it contributes nothing to the damage fight and is omitted.

The engine casts Tidal Wave (R) automatically at t = 0; Tidecaller's Blessing (E) is cast on herself at the same instant so its empowered charges are already armed when the wave lands 0.5 s later at the end of its cast.

Aqua Prison (Q) is cast on cooldown; its bubble lands 0.99 s after the cast starts (the wiki's stated combined cast-time-plus-travel figure), and the cooldown timer starts at the cast, not the landing.

Ebb and Flow (W) is cast on cooldown; only its initial hit on the dummy is counted as damage, since with no allied unit present the bounce cannot find a second unaffected enemy and the dummy is already 'affected' by the initial hit - the most literal reading of the alternating-bounce rule for a solo-dummy fight.

Tidecaller's Blessing (E) is recast on herself on cooldown; its 3 empowered-hit charges are consumed by whichever damage instance lands first among basic attacks, Q, W or R while the 6 s buff is up, and unused charges lapse when it expires.
Nami auto-attacks the dummy in every gap between casts; an attack carries Tidecaller's Blessing's bonus on-hit magic damage whenever a charge is armed.
Tidecaller's Blessing's reduced-damage rule against non-champions does not apply here, since the dummy counts as an enemy champion.
Tidal Wave's travel beyond its 0.5 s cast time is not modeled, since the dummy's distance from Nami is unspecified; its damage is applied when the cast completes.
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing here would exhaust Nami's mana inside a 15 s fight at level 16.
